location: shared troubleshooting item 'jupyter is not recognized' (printed in Sections 6.12, 6.20 and 6.26 and in every notebook's section 2 and set-up comments); owned by the infra agent, so not edited here

In the case the text names (environment not active), 'python' is also the system Python, which has no jupyter at all.
evidence: On this machine (Python 3.14.5; packages installed in the user site, whose Scripts folder is not on PATH): 'python -m jupyter nbconvert --version' prints 'Jupyter command `jupyter-nbconvert` not found.' and 'python -m jupyter lab --version' prints 'Jupyter command `jupyter-lab` not found.'. 'python -m nbconvert --version' prints 7.16.6 and 'python -m jupyterlab --version' prints 4.4.10.
fix: Infra: suggest 'python -m jupyterlab <notebook>' and 'python -m nbconvert --to notebook --execute --inplace <notebook>' as the fallbacks, after Step 4 has activated the environment. Then rebuild all notebooks, because the instruction text changes.
